$rules: Cool daylight only: north-window or softbox light, grey or white backdrops, no warm spa tones, no gold hour, no clinical blue gels. No before/after composites, no marked-up faces, no operating theatres. Alt text is descriptive text and ends with a period. Scripts read this file in scripts/exec/30_images.js.

caseFramesRule: The four case frames must be the same sitter, same backdrop and same light, picked by hand from one photographer series. Put the chosen URLs in scripts/ids.json → imagePicks. The script never auto-picks case frames, because four different strangers would make the signature dishonest.
